title: TestResidentAdmission_matrix is tautological and cannot fail
reason: Test assertion is unreachable by construction; stays green even if ResidentBackendFeatures emptied. Defect is in the test, not product code.

title: Metal snapshot golden pins a stream production never produces
reason: Filed as gate defect: golden hashes Forward without embed scale, not the shipped path. Product-side embed-scale miss is B-11's finding; R considered.

title: Generated capability matrix depends on ambient environment variables
reason: Test/generator reads GOINFER_* env, so freshness check flakes and -update can bake a wrong matrix. Test-harness defect.

title: residencyBufs recorded only in default arm, slots arm unchecked by gate
reason: Missing bookkeeping in explicit slots arm only disables the staleness gate; arm is handled, not unregistered, so not R; not arithmetic, so not N.

title: EncodeSegments gate keyed on hardcoded developer GGUF path
reason: Byte-identity/injection gate skips on every other machine, so regressions ship green. Test defect.

title: 34 hardcoded developer-home model paths make tests skip elsewhere
reason: Tests skip on all but two machines (29% skip on Mac); gates cannot run, so cannot fail.

title: No ReadTimeout, connection cap; expensive work before max-queue gate
reason: Unbounded concurrency and slow-body pinning where the code holds no limit at all: resource exhaustion, which the rubric puts in O, not B.

title: top_p 0 disables nucleus filtering, yielding maximum entropy
reason: Explicit top_p=0 (and negatives) unaccounted for, treated as the default no-nucleus case; fix adds a greedy case plus refusal. Alternative O (request validation).
path_missed: prepare top_p mapping / sampler TopP>0 check

title: Omitted seed becomes seed 0, making server fully deterministic
reason: Default-seed semantics violate OpenAI contract; API/request-handling behaviour, not an unregistered value, limit, or arithmetic error.

title: Context-clamped generation reports finish_reason stop instead of length
reason: streamTokens knows the budget but compares against requested, not clamped, value; fix plumbs effective budget, not a registration. Alternative O (API contract).

title: Forced tool_choice silently degrades to unconstrained decoding
reason: Families with no ToolCallWrapper (gemma3/gemma4) and unenforceable schemas fall through to default unconstrained path; fix is a named 400 refusal. Alternative O.
option_or_family: gemma3, gemma4 (ToolCallWrapper ok=false); unsupported schema keywords

title: Completions endpoint types logprobs as bool, never returns them
reason: Request schema/API-shape mismatch with OpenAI plus leaked Go field names; compatibility commitment, not registration, limit or arithmetic.

title: EAGLE entry points skip arch check for capture seam
reason: Families ForwardCapture rejects (MLA/DeepSeek etc.) are admitted by GenerateEagleSpeculative*, panic in fuseAt; fix applies allow-list/canBatchN guard.

title: loadWeights leaks checkpoint mmap on about forty error paths
reason: Resource leak on error paths; rubric lists leaks under O.

title: Metal PrefillLast binds model-level RoPE table and window
reason: Prefill handles sliding window but binds the wrong (model-level) buffers instead of per-layer ones; wrong binding, not an unregistered feature. Alternative R (prefillFeatures admission).

title: Metal int4 pack never checks K multiple of 32
reason: Kernels hard-assume K%32==0 and nothing checks it; fix is a decline in pack entry points. Alternative N (pack layout).
path_missed: metal int4 pack entry points / BuildResident

title: Metal dynamic threadgroup memory never validated against device limit
reason: Threadgroup memory sized from model dims exceeds 32 KB device limit with no check; fix is query limit and decline.

title: WebGPU attention kernels assume head_dim at most 128 unchecked
reason: Fixed workgroup size and 128-entry array exceeded by HeadDim>128 with no check in admission; fix is a decline.

title: DecodePiece strips leading space from every token
reason: Path knows the strip option but applies sequence-level strip per token, giving wrong output. Logic rather than arithmetic; alternative O.

title: LoadJSONBytes reads sibling tokenizer config from process CWD
reason: Wrong path derivation (literal filename resolves to CWD) adopts unrelated config; fix adds a parameter. Alternative R (loader branch missing bytes-only mode).

title: Qwen preprocess input image dimensions unbounded
reason: Code caps output only and holds no limit on input dimensions; unbounded allocation is O per rubric, not B.

title: GPU buffer leaks on matmul and vision error paths
reason: Buffer leaks on error paths; rubric lists leaks under O.

title: CUDA MoE groups cap published as 32, runtime allows 64
reason: Wrong mirrored constant makes published capability matrix contradict runtime and comment's one-source claim; no unchecked overrun, so not B. Alternatives B/N.

title: CI never compiles gpu or metal wired serve binary
reason: CI job's hand-written wired-serve build list covers cuda only, so gpu/metal tag wiring drift ships green.

title: Root go.mod drags whole GPU dependency set to CPU consumers
reason: Module-graph/release mechanics; the CI guard gap is secondary to the dependency leak.

title: NOTICE and third-party licenses miss x/sys and aikit/gpu
reason: License attribution and release mechanics. Alternative G (doc not saying what it claims).

title: No context.Context on multi-gigabyte transcode functions
reason: Missing cancellation in exported API; breaking-change risk is API shape.

title: cuda.SpecStats and decoder.SpecStats share a name, differ
reason: Exported type naming/API shape issue.

title: Config and Weights expose mutable live internals
reason: Exported API returns mutable pointers into precomputed state; API-shape footgun, not an unregistered case.
